narrative: Brutal week on the injury wire, folks. D'Andre Swift slid from Questionable to OUT, and he's got plenty of company — Luther Burden III (concussion), Rhamondre Stevenson (toe), Cam Skattebo and Tucker Kraft are all sidelined. Worse, Joe Burrow, Mike Evans and Braelon Allen have all landed on IR, so start making longer-term plans at those spots. The one real debate this week is Dak Prescott, where the experts can't agree on anything: Mike Harmon has him as high as QB5 while Nathan Jahnke buries him at QB21. That's a 16-spot spread — trust your own read, because the pros sure aren't helping.
